text: The Equity and Diversity Team will lead the Advisory Committee in the development of a work plan.

The Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer and Two-Spirit Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Director, Equity and Human Rights, People and Equity to develop a list of priority issues of interest, based on the Committee's discussion, to be shared back with the Committee to inform its development of a strategic work plan. 2. Included a review of the Committee name and acronym in the Committee's work plan, to ensure the City is relevant to today's society and needs.
